textos.Acertaste {a} de {n}. Las que fallaste v: You got {a} of {n} right. The ones you missed come back soon so you can learn them.
textos.Dime cuándo y te preparo un repaso para: Tell me when and I'll prepare a review so you're ready.
textos.Elige tu perfil para seguir donde quedas: Pick your profile to continue where you left off.
textos.Este tema no tiene fotos ni archivos: vi: This topic has no photos or files: it came from the catalog or was written by hand.
textos.Fotos (JPG, PNG) o PDF. Que se lea bien: Photos (JPG, PNG) or PDF. Make sure it's readable and well lit.
textos.Gratis, sin cuentas y sin publicidad. To: Free, no accounts and no ads. Everything stays on this computer.
textos.No entendí, explícamelo de otra forma: I don't get it, explain it another way
Repasa checks on its own every 6 hours.
textos.Repasa usa la IA que ya tiene un adulto: Repasa uses the AI a grown-up at home already has (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini), with their account. We'll test it with a short question.
textos.Repasa va a darle prioridad a estos tema: Repasa will prioritize these topics in the days before.
textos.Saca una foto a tu cuaderno y Repasa arm: Take a photo of your notebook and Repasa builds the questions.
textos.Si algo no calza con tu cuaderno, vuelve: If something doesn't match your notebook, try again. Nothing is saved until you say yes.
textos.Solo un nombre o apodo y el curso. Nada: Just a name or nickname and the grade. Nothing else.
textos.Sácale fotos a tu cuaderno o a la guía,: Take photos of your notebook or worksheet, or paste the text. {ia} builds the summary, the questions and the flashcards.
textos.Toca una tarjeta para darla vuelta. Inte: Tap a card to flip it. Try to answer before looking.
textos.Todo queda en este computador. La IA usa: Everything stays on this computer. The AI uses a grown-up's account and only sees the material you add and the questions.
textos.Una app para estudiar con lo que pasan e: An app to study what you're learning at school. Snap a photo of the notebook and Repasa builds an easy summary, test-style questions and flashcards. Tricky questions come back until they're learned.
textos.Vuelve mañana o practica un tema que qui: Come back tomorrow or practice any topic you like.
textos.{ia} está leyendo tu material y escribie: {ia} is reading your material and writing the questions. It may take a minute.
textos.{ia} está pensando otra forma de explica: {ia} is thinking of another way to explain it…
textos.Ej.: el resumen que dictó la profesora: E.g.: the summary the teacher dictated
Add a photo, a PDF or paste the text.
textos.Todavía no tienes temas de este ramo. Ag: You don't have topics for this subject yet. Add them with a notebook photo.
textos.Piensa en una carrera de postas: la Patr: Think of a relay race: the Patria Vieja was the first lap, at Rancagua the baton was dropped (the Reconquista), and with Chacabuco the team picked it up and kept running: the Patria Nueva. (In the preview this explanation is a sample; in the app your AI writes one for each question.)
textos.En la app, aquí se abre la carpeta: In the app, the folder opens here
textos.Una foto por página: de cerca, derecha y: One photo per page: close up, straight and with good light.
textos.El material era largo y usé solo la prim: The material was long, so I only used the first part. For a long topic, create it in two parts.
textos.Escribe tú las preguntas, sin IA. Repasa: Write the questions yourself, no AI needed. Repasa builds the topic and checks it before saving.
textos.Una pregunta por bloque, separadas por u: One question per block, separated by a blank line. * marks the right answer, - the wrong ones and > the explanation. Use ___ for fill-in-the-blank.
textos.Uno por línea: «Término: definición». Ta: One per line: “Term: definition”. They also become flashcards.
textos.en alternativas va una sola correcta (*): multiple choice has exactly one right answer (*) and 3 to 5 options in total.
textos.no sé qué tipo de pregunta es (agrega op: I can't tell what kind of question it is (add options with -, ___ for fill-in-the-blank, or * True / * False).
textos.Temas de ejemplo revisados a mano, listo: Sample topics, checked by hand and ready to study.
You already have every topic in the catalog.
textos.Este teléfono no tiene IA propia todavía: This phone doesn't have its own AI yet.
textos.Igual puedes escribir el tema a mano o e: You can still write the topic by hand or pick one from the catalog.
What {ia} made isn't usable yet ({x}). Try again or with a clearer photo.
textos.Todo queda en este teléfono. La IA es la: Everything stays on this phone. The AI is the phone's own: it doesn't use the internet and only sees the material you add and the questions.
textos.Gratis, sin cuentas y sin publicidad. To: Free, no accounts and no ads. Everything stays on this phone.
textos.En el celular, Repasa usa la IA del prop: On the phone, Repasa uses the phone's own AI: free, private and offline. If this phone doesn't have it, you can still write topics by hand or pick them from the catalog.
textos.Guarda una copia cifrada en iCloud Drive: Save an encrypted copy to iCloud Drive or Google Drive and bring it to another phone. It only opens with your family's passphrase: write it down somewhere safe, because nobody can recover it.
textos.Por ejemplo, cuatro palabras que solo us: For example, four words only your family knows
textos.Copia guardada ({n} archivos). Nadie pue: Copy saved ({n} files). Nobody can open it without the passphrase.
textos.Listo: se juntaron {t} temas nuevos y el: Done: {t} new topics and the progress of {p} profiles were merged. Nothing was deleted.
textos.Este iPhone no tiene Apple Intelligence: This iPhone doesn't have Apple Intelligence (it needs an iPhone 15 Pro or newer).
textos.Activa Apple Intelligence en Ajustes del: Turn on Apple Intelligence in the iPhone's Settings.
textos.Apple Intelligence se está preparando en: Apple Intelligence is getting ready on this iPhone. Try again in a while.
textos.La IA de este teléfono no está disponibl: This phone's AI isn't available right now.
This phone doesn't have Gemini Nano.
textos.Gemini Nano se está descargando en este: Gemini Nano is downloading on this phone. Try again in a while.
textos.Muy pronto: el computador de la casa har: Coming soon: the family computer will do the work with its AI, through the family folder.
textos.La IA del teléfono no quiso responder co: The phone's AI wouldn't answer with this material (its filters are strict). Try another photo or write it by hand.
textos.El material es muy largo para la IA del: The material is too long for the phone's AI. Try fewer photos.
textos.La IA del teléfono todavía no entiende e: The phone's AI doesn't understand this language yet.
textos.La IA de este teléfono no pudo responder: This phone's AI couldn't answer. Try again.
textos.Este teléfono no tiene IA propia. Puedes: This phone doesn't have its own AI. You can write the topic by hand or pick one from the catalog.
textos.Este teléfono no puede leer fotos. Escri: This phone can't read photos. Type or paste the text.
textos.No pude leer texto en las fotos. Prueba: I couldn't read any text in the photos. Try closer, straight and with good light.
textos.Para explicarlo de otra forma hace falta: Explaining it another way needs the phone's AI.
textos.El archivo está dañado o no es una copia: The file is damaged or isn't a Repasa copy.
textos.Usa una frase de al menos 12 caracteres: Use a passphrase of at least 12 characters (for example, four words).
textos.Agrega una foto o escribe el texto que h: Add a photo or type the text to study.
textos.no escribió el título y el resumen: it didn't write the title and summary
textos.titulo: texto de 1 a 80 caracteres, sin: The title must be 1 to 80 characters, without HTML.
textos.resumen: la explicación fácil del tema (: The easy explanation can be up to 3000 characters, without HTML.
the question must be 1 to 300 characters.
the explanation must be 1 to 500 characters.
textos.en completar, correcta es la lista de re: fill-in-the-blank answers must be short (1 to 4 accepted answers, up to 40 characters).
textos.el enunciado de completar lleva ___ dond: a fill-in-the-blank question needs ___ where the answer goes.
textos.Fotos (JPG, PNG) o PDF; también puedes a: Photos (JPG, PNG) or a PDF; you can also drag them here. Make sure they're clear and well lit.
textos.Solo fotos (JPG, PNG) o PDF de hasta 25: Only photos (JPG, PNG) or PDFs up to 25 MB.
textos.No pude revisar: ¿hay internet?: I couldn't check: are you online?
textos.Instalando: Repasa se cerrará y volverá: Installing: Repasa will close and open again by itself
textos.No pude descargar la versión nueva. Revi: I couldn't download the new version. Check your connection and try again.
textos.No pude preparar la versión nueva. Repas: I couldn't get the new version ready. Repasa is the same as before; try again later.
textos.Espera a que termine de armar el tema y: Wait until the topic is ready and try again.
textos.No encontré la descarga de la versión nu: I couldn't find the download for the new version.
textos.En la vista previa no hay nada que actua: There's nothing to update in the preview.
textos.Guarda una copia cifrada en iCloud Drive: Save an encrypted copy to iCloud Drive or another folder and bring it to another computer or phone. It only opens with your family's passphrase: write it down somewhere safe, because nobody can recover it.
textos.Elige las fotos del cuaderno o la guía,: Choose photos of the notebook or worksheet, or a PDF
textos.Dónde guardar la copia cifrada: Where to save the encrypted copy
textos.La copia no está lista en esta app todav: Copies aren't ready in this app yet. Try again after updating Repasa.
textos.No encontré {ia} en este computador. Rev: I couldn't find {ia} on this computer. Check Settings → Your AI.
textos.{ia} se demoró demasiado en responder. I: {ia} took too long to answer. Please try again.
textos.Actualiza {ia} para usarla con {app}: tu: Update {ia} to use it with {app}: your version doesn't know the protections we need.
